ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture
fsm_summary: SWD wire-level state machine sequences each 46-bit transaction through 6 phases (Request → Turnaround → ACK → Data → Parity → Turnaround). SWDIO direction flips at the Turnaround periods. The SWJ-DP variant adds a mode-select state machine that watches for the 16-bit JTAG-to-SWD (0xE79E) and SWD-to-JTAG (0xE73C) selection sequences.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: Idle
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Between transactions. SWDIO is host-driven HIGH.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: RequestRx
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Target shifts in the 8-bit Request packet.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: DataDrive_Read
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Read + ACK=OK: target drives 32 data bits.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: DataDrive_Write
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Write + ACK=OK: host drives 32 data bits.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: ParityDrive_Write
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Write: host drives parity; target checks → WDATAERR on mismatch.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: WaitOrFault
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: ACK=WAIT or FAULT: host ignores data.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: LineResetDetect
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Detects 50+ SWCLKs with SWDIO=HIGH; forces SW-DP Idle.

fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.name: WatchSWDSelect
fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.description: After ≥ 50 cycles TMS=1, watches for 0xE79E pattern.

fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.name: WatchJTAGSelect
fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.description: After ≥ 50 cycles SWDIO=1, watches for 0xE73C pattern.

fsm_hints.trigger: A debug session begins after the DP power-up handshake (CDBGPWRUPREQ/ACK, CSYSPWRUPREQ/ACK) completes; only then can the debugger walk ROM Tables and program components.
fsm_hints.rule: A component's registers may need the software lock cleared (write the key to LAR) before writes take effect; AUTHSTATUS / the DBGEN-class signals gate whether invasive/Secure debug is permitted.
fsm_hints.abort: If authentication is denied or the power-up ack is not granted, debug accesses fault and the session cannot proceed.

anti_deadlock_rule: 50-cycle line reset is the universal escape — there is no SWD state from which this sequence does not return to Idle. Guarantees host can always recover SWD without power-cycling.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On connection, the DP is reset, DPIDR is read, the debug and system power domains are requested and acknowledged, an Access Port is selected, then the debugger reads BASE, walks the ROM Tables, identifies components by CIDR/PIDR/DEVARCH/DEVTYPE, and programs the trace sources/links/sinks and cross-triggers before capturing trace.

default_ready_state_recommendation.SWCLK: Idle level not specified; debug probe drives. Most probes leave SWCLK low between transactions.

configurations.name: Single-target SWD
configurations.description: One SoC on the SWD bus; host directly drives SWCLK/SWDIO.

configurations.name: Multi-drop SWD
configurations.description: Multiple SoCs share SWDIO/SWCLK; per-target selection via DP TARGETSEL (ADIv5.2).

configurations.name: SWJ-DP mode-switched
configurations.description: SoC supports both SWD and JTAG; mode is selected at runtime via 16-bit selection sequences.

timing_dependency_rule: All transaction-state-machine transitions are synchronous to SWCLK. Target drives SWDIO on the falling edge during target-driven phases; host samples on the rising edge.

swd_to_jtag_mode_switching.selection_sequence_preconditions: Both selection sequences must be preceded by ≥ 50 cycles of SWDIO/TMS=HIGH and followed by ≥ 50 cycles of SWDIO/TMS=HIGH.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: DP_RESET
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: Debug Port reset / line reset; DP registers in reset state.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: DPIDR_READ
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: Debugger reads DPIDR/IDCODE to identify the DP.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: PWRUP_REQ
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: Set CDBGPWRUPREQ and CSYSPWRUPREQ in CTRL/STAT to power the debug and system domains.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: PWRUP_ACK
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: Wait for CDBGPWRUPACK and CSYSPWRUPACK; only then may AP accesses proceed.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: AP_SELECT
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: Program SELECT to choose the Access Port and register bank.

fsm_states_dap_powerup.name: DAP_READY
fsm_states_dap_powerup.description: DAP operational; MEM-AP TAR/DRW accesses to the debug register space allowed.

fsm_states_discovery.name: READ_BASE
fsm_states_discovery.description: Read the MEM-AP BASE register to locate the top-level ROM Table.

fsm_states_discovery.name: WALK_ROMTABLE
fsm_states_discovery.description: Read ROM Table entries; each present entry gives a relative offset to a component or nested ROM Table.

fsm_states_discovery.name: IDENTIFY
fsm_states_discovery.description: At each component base, read CIDR0-3 / PIDR0-7 / DEVARCH / DEVTYPE to positively identify it.

fsm_states_discovery.name: ENUMERATED
fsm_states_discovery.description: Full component inventory (cores, ETMs, ITM/STM, funnel, replicator, CTIs, sinks) is known.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: UNLOCK_CLAIM
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Write LAR lock key (unlock) and CLAIMSET claim tags on each component to be programmed.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: CFG_SOURCE
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Program trace sources (ETM/ITM/STM): trace enable, ATB trace ID, comparators/stimulus.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: CFG_LINK
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Enable the relevant funnel input ports and route the replicator output(s) to the chosen sink.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: CFG_SINK
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Configure the sink: TPIU formatter/port-width, ETB/ETF buffer mode, or ETR AXI scatter-gather buffer.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: CFG_XTRIG
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Program the CTIs (channel in/out mappings) and the CTM for cross-triggering.

fsm_states_trace_session.name: CAPTURE
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Trace flows on the ATB to the sink; off-chip (TPIU/SWO), on-chip (ETB/ETF), or to DRAM (ETR/AXI).

fsm_states_trace_session.name: DRAIN_DECODE
fsm_states_trace_session.description: Stop capture, drain the buffer over the Debug APB (or from DRAM), and decode off-line using the trace IDs and the program image.

cross_trigger_logic: Each CTI maps local trigger inputs/outputs onto channels via CTIINEN/CTIOUTEN; an event raised with CTIAPPSET/CTIAPPPULSE on a channel is broadcast by the CTM to every CTI listening on that channel, which drives its mapped trigger output (e.g. a halt on one core halts all cores; a single restart releases them together).
